desc: Read input $N, X$, arrays $A, B, P, Q$. Convert $P, Q$ to 0-based indexing.
Identify the cycle containing $X$ in permutation $P$ and store it in `cycle_P`.
Identify the cycle containing $X$ in permutation $Q$ and store it in `cycle_Q`.
For every $i$ where $A_i=1$, check if $i \in \text{cycle\_P}$. If not, print -1.
For every $i$ where $B_i=1$, check if $i \in \text{cycle\_Q}$. If not, print -1.
Perform a BFS/DFS to find the set of boxes that need to be operated on:
Initialize a queue with all $i \neq X$ such that $A_i + B_i > 0$.
Maintain a `visited` set to track processed boxes.
While the queue is not empty, pop $u$, add $P_u$ and $Q_u$ to the queue if they are not $X$ and not yet visited.
Print the size of the `visited` set (total operations).
Verify logic with provided sample cases mentally. Ensure edge cases (no balls, X has balls initially, disconnected components) are handled. The code seems robust. Ready for execution.
